# Weekly Trading Review

**Monday 09:00 · 45 minutes · Founders + all leads**
Filled in **before** the meeting. If it is not filled in, the meeting does not happen.

---

| Metric | Last week | This week | Δ | Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Orders | | | | | |
| AOV (P) | | | | | |
| Contribution / order (P) | | | | | |
| Contribution / route / week (P) | | | | | |
| First-attempt success % | | | | | |

## 2. Failures (10 min)

Every failed drop, refund and complaint from the week. Grouped by reason code.

| Reason code | Count | Root cause | Fix | Owner | By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | |

**Rule:** a reason code with no fix owner is the only unacceptable outcome of this meeting.

## 3. Money (5 min)

- Cash collected vs expected. Variance: ______
- Refunds issued: ______ · Refunds outstanding > 72h: ______
- Any payment not received but order shipped? (If yes: stop, explain, fix the control.)

## 4. Supply (5 min)

- Top-20 SKUs out of stock: ______
- Sellers below 95% fill rate: ______
- Listings live without a real photograph: ______ (target: zero)

## 5. Three actions (15 min)

Exactly three. Each with one owner and a date. Not five, not ten.

1. ______________________________________ — [owner] — by [date]
2. ______________________________________ — [owner] — by [date]
3. ______________________________________ — [owner] — by [date]

## 6. Carried forward

Last week's three actions: how many closed? ___ / 3
If fewer than 2 closed, the meeting agenda next week is *only* why.
